literal: Even if the aeon changes, they will not change, those who are called the ocean to perfection.
translation: Those who are called the ocean of perfection will not change, even if the aeons themselves change.
modern: உலகம் அழியும் ஊழிக்காலம் வந்து மாறினாலும், சான்றாண்மைக்குக் கடல் என்று சிறப்பிக்கப்படுபவர்கள் தம் நற்குணங்களிலிருந்து மாற மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: The couplet compares people of perfect character to an ocean, emphasizing their vastness and stability. The word 'ஊழி' refers to an aeon or the end of the world, a time of ultimate upheaval. Even if the entire world undergoes such a cataclysmic change, these noble individuals will not waver from their virtues. They are thus called the ocean ('ஆழி') of perfection ('சான்றாண்மைக்கு'), remaining steadfast and uncontainable in their goodness.
